_doc: BOONE TRUCKS (naming bible §7) — Wade 'The Bullet' Boone's lot on the I-3 north frontage. Every tunable the dealer has: prices, the note's terms, the sign copy, the prompt strings, Wade's lines and BOONE FINANCIAL's draft notices. The satire is the NOTE, never the customer: 96 months at $0 down, a multiplier in the fine print, and LONGHORN WRECKER & RECOVERY on the other end of it. Wade is tragicomic, never a victim. Geometry lives in dealer.gd; words and money live here.
_note_apr_total: The note costs 31% more over its life than the cash price. monthly = ceil(price * note_apr_total / note_months); interest = monthly*note_months - price. Brisket $28,700 -> $392/mo -> $37,632 paid -> $8,932 in interest.
_day_seconds: One in-game day of play. BOONE FINANCIAL drafts once per day, counted off play time so it is true headless and never depends on sky_weather being present.
_miss_limit: Returned drafts before LONGHORN comes. Two. Wade would tell you that is generous, and by his standards it is.
_display_gap_m: Clear metres of asphalt between bumpers in the front line; centres are spaced by the two half-lengths plus this.

sign.name: BOONE TRUCKS
sign.terms: 96 MONTHS · $0 DOWN · YOUR SIGNATURE IS YOUR CREDIT

prompt.buy: G  SIGN THE NOTE — {name}  ${monthly}/mo × {months}      HOLD G  PAY CASH  ${price}

cash_short: Wade says: 'Cash is for people who don't trust themselves.'
cash_short_line: Cash is for people who don't trust themselves.
wade_lines: Ninety-six months. That's eight football seasons. You'll be a different man.
Don't read it out loud — you'll talk yourself out of it. Read it quiet. That's how I read mine.
Zero down. Zero. I called three banks before one of 'em thought that was funny.
Your signature is your credit out here. Mine's on eleven things and I sleep like a baby.
You're not buying a truck. You're buying a Saturday. Every Saturday. Till 2034.
My daddy paid cash for everything and died with four hundred dollars. I'd rather owe and drive.
Folks ask do I ever feel bad. I feel great. Feelin's the one thing around here that ain't financed.
Appreciate you. Genuinely. You just made a payroll you will never once get to see.
wade_cash_lines: Cash. Alright. That's a man who's been disappointed before.
No note, no draft, no me callin' you in March. Kinda miss you already.
Paid in full. Now what am I supposed to put on the board?

app.speaker: BOONE FINANCIAL
app.paid: BOONE FINANCIAL: ${monthly} drafted. {left} to go. Appreciate you!
missed: BOONE FINANCIAL: draft returned. That's one.
BOONE FINANCIAL: draft returned. That's two.
app.missed_more: BOONE FINANCIAL: draft returned. That's {missed}. We've stopped counting out loud.
app.signed: BOONE FINANCIAL: welcome aboard. First draft in one day. ${monthly}, ninety-six times.

repo.speaker: LONGHORN · RECOVERY
repo.line: YOUR VEHICLE HAS BEEN RECOVERED. WE OWN THAT TOO.
repo.warn: LONGHORN · RECOVERY: a unit is en route to your last known address.

wade_greet_lines: Number twelve. You remember. Everybody remembers. Come look at the Brisket.
Ninety-six months is eight football seasons. You'll be a different man. Appreciate you.
I don't sell trucks. I sell Fridays. Sign something.
That wrecker's a job. This lot's a life. Walk with me.
Zero down. Your signature IS your credit. That's not a slogan, that's the law in this county.
My knees went in '09 and I still made quota. You'll make yours.
